idea-plugin.name: Cranpose
idea-plugin.description:
Cranpose development tools for IntelliJ IDEA and RustRover, with a tool window written in Cranpose.

  • Discover Cargo workspace binaries and examples that use Cranpose.
  • Check, run and test targets with build output in the IDE.
  • Interactive embedded previews, theme switching and layout inspection.
  • Composable gutter markers, source navigation and component completions.
  • Create a working Cranpose application in an empty project.

Install JetBrains Rust support for full Rust language editing. Preview applications need Cranpose's embed feature. See the repository for setup and supported framework versions.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial development release with Cargo integration, composable editing and interactive previews.
